name: Eleni Papageorgiou
bio:
Eleni's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. While studying mechanical engineering at the National Technical University of Athens, a class visit to a local racing team sparked an intense interest in aerodynamics. She pursued this passion, landing an internship with a smaller Formula team before eventually joining Aston Martin. 

As a wind tunnel operator, Eleni is meticulous and precise. She believes in the power of data and carefully analyzes every run, looking for subtle improvements that can give the team an edge. Her calm demeanor allows her to thrive under pressure, ensuring accurate results even when deadlines are tight. She is known for her ability to spot potential problems early on, preventing costly mistakes and keeping the team on schedule.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back into a practical ponytail during work.
physical.description: Eleni has a warm smile and a focused gaze that reflects her dedication to her work.

quirks: Always has a thermos of chamomile tea at her workstation.
Meticulously organizes her tools and equipment before each session.
Often hums quietly while reviewing data, a habit she's unaware of.
